stops.title: Deɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ
stops.caption: Mmaeɛ, nkɔsoɔ, nkitahodie.
stops.speech: Amanneɛbɔ fa mmaeɛ nkɔsoɔ, asɔrefoɔ dodoɔ nkɔanim, nkitahodie ne asɛmpaka ho, biara sɛdeɛ wo dibea tumi hunu.

stops.title: Sesa berɛ no
stops.caption: Bosome a atwam, anaa afe.
stops.speech: Sesa berɛ no ma ɛtrɛ anaa ɛte so. Akontaa no ne mfonini biara di akyi.
